description.en: Planned animal asset: compact furred body with spine-bearing skin patches.
description.zh: 规划中的动物资产：有棘皮区的紧凑有毛身体。

scientific_scope.en: Living reconstruction proposal, not a scanned specimen. A named museum or primary reference supports identity and specified evidence. The proposed whole form and low-poly distinction still require the listed production gate.
scientific_scope.zh: 活体复原方案，并非扫描标本。具名博物馆或一手资料支持身份及指定证据。拟议整体形态与低多边形差异仍须通过所列制作关卡。

distinctness.en: Shape criterion: compact furred body with spine-bearing skin patches. Retain this anatomical combination when compared with nearby forms; a name, scale or pose change alone does not qualify.
distinctness.zh: 形态判据：有棘皮区的紧凑有毛身体。须与相近形态对照保留这一结构组合；仅改名称、尺寸或姿态不成立。

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly brief: block compact furred body with spine-bearing skin patches with a small number of readable masses; preserve negative spaces and joint transitions. Use a restrained neutral palette; simplify surface texture only after the silhouette reads. Validate the diagnostic feature before detailed geometry.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形说明：用少量清晰体块组织有棘皮区的紧凑有毛身体；保留负空间与关节过渡。采用克制的中性色；轮廓成立后再简化表面纹理。精细几何制作前须核实鉴别特征。

uncertainty: Skin, color and unpreserved soft tissues are not established by this inventory. Choose a species and specimen before final anatomy approval.

reference_notes.en: Spinolestes xenarthrosus: Early Cretaceous Spain, preserved pelage, pinna, dermal scutes and protospines, articulated specimen. Taxon-specific source checked; this does not approve every proposed reconstruction detail.
reference_notes.zh: 已核实该属的专门资料；所列来源仅支持相应身份与结构，不代表全部复原细节已获批准。

sources.title: Introduction to the Synapsida
sources.supports: Synapsids include mammals and their extinct relatives; non-mammalian synapsids must not be labeled true reptiles; Dimetrodon finback form.

sources.title: A Cretaceous eutriconodont and integument evolution in early mammals
